notes.title: A new judge cat, 'Lady Meow-nalisa,' has been added!
notes.notes:
Count Leo-meow-rdo's wife, Lady Meow-nalisa, is said to be very strict about beauty and food.
Can you impress her refined palate even more than the Count's, nya?

notes.title: New feature: Review Mode added, along with winter ingredients!
notes.notes:
In Review Mode, the judge cat 'Count Leo-meow-rdo' will review the dishes he has created!
Make dishes that match the Count's taste and aim for a high score!
Additionally, winter ingredients such as mandarins, mochi, and Chinese cabbage have been added.
Try making some delicious winter dishes!
